evidence: PowerToys 0.100.2 is running elevated on Windows 11 24H2.
The reporter attached a diagnostic ZIP and a keyboard-test screenshot showing key-up events while Alt/Win key-down no longer registers in a foreground window.
The symptom usually appears around full-screen games, but no specific game, window mode, configured modifier, or exact transition is known.
Input works again on the desktop or outside a non-maximized foreground window.
judgment.recommended_action: Request the exact app/window mode, modifier/settings, focus transition, and recovery action from the next occurrence; acknowledge that the existing ZIP is already useful.

issue_context.summary: Grab and Move intermittently leaves Alt and Win shortcuts unusable only in certain foreground contexts, with key-up still observed and normal behavior returning outside that context.
known_information: The report includes version, OS, elevation state, screenshot, and a diagnostic ZIP.
Alt+Tab, Win+Space, and the Start key fail in the affected foreground context.
The reporter cannot yet reproduce deterministically and offered to identify involved programs if it recurs.
Grab and Move supports Alt or Win and explicitly tracks absorbed/replayed modifier state.
inferences: A foreground-application or focus-transition interaction may be involved, but current evidence does not establish which hook owns the missing key-down.
Because desktop interaction restores shortcuts, the failure may be context-dependent rather than a globally stuck physical key.
issue_context.analysis: A new generic diagnostic request would duplicate supplied evidence. The useful next step is to capture the exact app, presentation mode, selected modifier, and recovery behavior so maintainers can choose between hook replay, exclusion, elevation, or compatibility investigation.
initial_investigation: Reviewed the complete issue and confirmed the diagnostic archive is already attached.
Inspected Grab and Move source: it has Alt/Win modifier modes and modifier absorption/replay paths.
No linked duplicate, fix PR, assignee, or maintainer ownership is present.

comment.body: Thanks for the 0.100.2 report, screenshot, and attached PowerToysReport. The remaining ambiguity is which foreground program/window mode and Grab and Move activation configuration leave Alt/Win key-down suppressed. On the next occurrence, please name the game or app, state whether it is exclusive full screen, borderless full screen, or windowed, provide the exact modifier setting and mouse action, and report whether switching to the desktop, disabling Grab and Move, or exiting PowerToys restores input. The existing ZIP is already useful; no replacement is needed unless the configuration changed.
